definition: Original local Yachida metadata group before official stage recovery. Uses coarse local labels only.
source: Local metadata.tsv / Borenstein curated Yachida metadata
allowed_values: Healthy; MP; HS; Stage_0; Stage_I_II; Stage_III_IV
intended_use: Audit original local metadata and define original cohort groups; do not mix with recovered Stage I-IV labels.

definition: Raw official individual stage value exactly as recovered from Yachida Supplementary Table S2-2.
source: Yachida et al. 2019 Nature Medicine Supplementary Table S2-2, column Stage
allowed_values: -; 0; I; IIA; IIC; IIIA; IIIB; IIIC; IVA; IVB; Iva; Ivb in the local subset
intended_use: Source provenance and reproducibility; preserve raw capitalization.

definition: Capitalization-normalized version of the official Stage field only.
allowed_values: None; 0; I; IIA; IIC; IIIA; IIIB; IIIC; IVA; IVB
intended_use: Internal consistency for grouping; not a new biological mapping.

definition: Major recovered official stage collapsed from normalized individual substages.
allowed_values: Stage 0; Stage I; Stage II; Stage III; Stage IV; missing for Healthy/MP/HS
intended_use: Yachida-only secondary Healthy vs Stage 0/I/II/III/IV analyses.

definition: Recovered official substage retained where present for Stage III and Stage IV.
allowed_values: IIIA; IIIB; IIIC; IVA; IVB; blank otherwise
intended_use: Descriptive audit only unless future sample size supports substage modelling.

definition: Human-readable label preserving official recovered stage or original non-CRC group.
allowed_values: Healthy; MP; HS; Stage 0; Stage I; Stage IIA; Stage IIC; Stage IIIA; Stage IIIB; Stage IIIC; Stage IVA; Stage IVB; Unknown
intended_use: Source-faithful reporting and exploratory fine labels.

definition: Clinically interpretable grouping of original groups and recovered official stages.
allowed_values: Healthy; Precursor lesion; Non-invasive CRC; Localized CRC; Regional CRC; Metastatic CRC; Post-surgical control; Unknown
intended_use: Coarse Yachida-only secondary/exploratory analyses; MP is not CRC and HS is not Healthy.

definition: Label used for the exploratory cross-sectional ordered disease-state variable.
allowed_values: Healthy; MP; Stage 0; Stage I; Stage IIA/IIC; Stage IIIA/IIIB/IIIC; Stage IVA/IVB; HS excluded
intended_use: Exploratory ordered disease-state description only; not observed longitudinal progression.

definition: Numeric order for independently sampled disease states.
allowed_values: Healthy=0; MP=1; Stage 0=2; Stage I=3; Stage II=4; Stage III=5; Stage IV=6; missing for HS
intended_use: Exploratory ordinal methods only; must not be interpreted as within-patient temporal follow-up.

definition: Primary binary CRC-vs-control label for Yachida component of the shared external-validation task.
source: Derived from recovered official stages and original Healthy group
allowed_values: Control for Healthy; CRC for Stage 0, Stage I, Stage II, Stage III, and Stage IV; missing/excluded for MP and HS
intended_use: Primary CRC vs Healthy task; externally validated only as binary CRC vs Control with Sinha.
